title: Chang'an translation-bureau network
shortSummary: Translation was collaborative work supported by monastic space, language roles, textual checking and imperial patronage.
curatorialDescription: It is modelled as a network so that bureaux in different monasteries and periods are not falsely merged into one permanent institution.
researchNote: Locations, participants, functions and dates must be separated by translation project.
